findings.mitigation: Adopt comments as evidence/handoff only; unblock authority stays agent quorum + deterministic gates.
findings.risk: Hermes human-in-the-loop board/comment semantics could conflict with Oyatie 100% autonomy.

findings.mitigation: Reject for deployment; allow only ephemeral CI/test runners with receipts and no runtime mutation authority.
findings.risk: Hermes shell/server backends could reintroduce deployment drift.

findings.mitigation: Only candidate artifacts are auto-managed; canonical specs/skills require PR/gates; delete is forbidden, archive is recoverable.
findings.risk: Agent-managed skills can become ungoverned mutable behavior.

amendment_plan.action: Add durable task/role workboard protocol with states, dependency links, comments, idempotency keys, isolation, and task ownership.
verification: future gate validates each active autonomous task has owner/status/evidence and no duplicate idempotency key

amendment_plan.action: Add heartbeat, claim TTL, reclaim, unified failure counter, max_retries, auto-block, and conservative-default linkage.
verification: future gate validates heartbeat/reclaim evidence for running tasks before completion claims

amendment_plan.action: Add machine-readable goal/subgoal/checkpoint/handoff receipts and retention guardrails.
verification: future gate validates handoff receipt has from_session, to_session, goal_id, checkpoint_id, status

amendment_plan.action: Add deterministic mutation receipts so agents cannot claim file edits without tool/git evidence.
verification: future gate compares claimed files in PR body/evidence to git diff and mutation receipts

amendment_plan.action: Constrain autonomous learning: candidate artifacts only, no deletion, archive recoverably, patch-first, protected canonical specs, empirical promotion.
verification: future gate denies auto-delete of canonical specs/skills and requires candidate/protected/pinned flags

amendment_plan.action: Add scheduled ops job lifecycle with fresh sessions, no recursive scheduling, tick lock, and ops/audit-chain delivery.
verification: future gate validates scheduled jobs have lock_key, recursion_disabled=true, delivery=ops/audit-chain

amendment_plan.action: Add non-overridable forbidden operations floor; explicitly reject yolo/off approval as an autonomy mechanism.
verification: future gate validates forbidden operations reference specs/forbidden-operations.json and deployment-ops-contract forbidden paths

amendment_plan.action: Add provider capability and credential-presence registry for vendor-distinct quorum dispatch without exposing raw secrets.
verification: future gate validates author/critic/tiebreaker providers are eligible, distinct where required, and within rate budget

mission: Identify Hermes Agent patterns adoptable into specs/agent-durable-goal.json#autonomous_foundry and produce adopt-or-reject verdicts plus an amendment plan.

oyatie_target.deployment_constraint: Do not import Hermes remote shell/manual server patterns into Oyatie deployment; deployment remains OpenTofu + ops-managed per specs/deployment-ops-contract.json.

patterns.name: durable_agent_workboard
patterns.oyatie_fit: Oyatie already models ChangeSets and VCS events; Hermes adds a concrete queue/board shape for durable autonomous role handoffs instead of ephemeral subagent context.
patterns.reject_or_constrain: Do not copy Hermes human-in-loop unblock semantics as authority; in Oyatie comments are evidence, and unblocking is by agent quorum + gates.

patterns.name: worker_liveness_reclaim_and_failure_circuit_breaker
patterns.oyatie_fit: Strengthens autonomous_foundry.stuck_loop_recovery with mechanical heartbeats, reclaim, zombie detection, per-task retry budgets, and failure auto-block instead of vague stuck detection.
patterns.reject_or_constrain: No manual SSH/process poking; liveness recovery must be repo/ops mediated and recorded in evidence rows.

patterns.name: gateway_embedded_dispatcher_not_standalone_daemon
patterns.oyatie_fit: The dispatcher belongs in the canonical ops/control-plane surface, not ad hoc scripts. This aligns with the OpenTofu + ops-only deployment directive.
patterns.reject_or_constrain: Implement through Oyatie ops runtime and VCS controller, not a local Python daemon or manual service install.

adopted_shape: resume after restart without losing pending prompts
patterns.name: persistent_goals_checkpoints_live_handoff
patterns.oyatie_fit: Oyatie has persistent_goal and handoffs but lacks a codified checkpoint retention and live handoff receipt model for agent session transfer.
patterns.reject_or_constrain: No Markdown-only handoffs as closure authority; canonical handoff receipts must be JSON/audit-chain rows.

adopted_shape: record intended file targets for mutating operations
record landed files independently of model summary
block completion if claimed file lacks receipt
patterns.name: per_turn_file_mutation_verifier
patterns.oyatie_fit: Directly addresses no-silent-regression and over-claiming risk: every mutating tool turn should produce mutation receipts and failed-target evidence.
patterns.reject_or_constrain: Do not rely on LLM self-report; receipts must be deterministic from tool outputs/git diff.

adopted_shape: candidate-to-blocker promotion based on empirical prevented incidents
patterns.name: curated_learning_loop_for_agent_created_procedures
patterns.oyatie_fit: Oyatie lane_promotion_protocol already promotes recurring drift; Hermes contributes recoverable archive, pinned/protected records, agent-created-only scope, and patch-first updates.
patterns.reject_or_constrain: No free-form skill self-mutation can bypass PR, score-card, and audit-chain gates.

adopted_shape: tooling prefers JSON pointers over bulk prose
patterns.name: progressive_disclosure_knowledge_surfaces
patterns.oyatie_fit: Useful for lowering agent context cost across masterplan/spec/product surfaces while keeping canonical machine-readable files authoritative.
patterns.reject_or_constrain: Do not make Markdown skills authoritative for Oyatie product/spec truth; JSON specs remain closure authority.

adopted_shape: memory citations separate from verification evidence
session facts never outrank repo specs
patterns.name: bounded_memory_plus_on_demand_session_search
patterns.oyatie_fit: Matches user preference: memory helps but live repo/spec truth wins. Separate tiny always-loaded memory from searchable evidence history.
patterns.reject_or_constrain: Do not allow memory-derived facts to satisfy gates without fresh verification when drift-prone.

patterns.name: scheduled_ops_jobs_with_loop_guard
patterns.oyatie_fit: Can power daily CI/PR/ops audits and release-readiness checks through ops. The no-recursive-scheduling and tick-lock patterns prevent runaway loops.
patterns.reject_or_constrain: No direct Telegram/Slack as control authority; notifications are mirrors of ops/audit-chain state.

patterns.name: hardline_forbidden_operations_floor
patterns.oyatie_fit: Hermes hardline blocklist maps cleanly to Oyatie forbidden-operations and deployment-ops-contract: some actions are never allowed, even when autonomous.
patterns.reject_or_constrain: Reject yolo/off approval modes as a governance primitive; autonomy means deterministic constraints, not unconstrained execution.

patterns.name: provider_capability_and_credential_registry
patterns.oyatie_fit: Oyatie requires vendor-distinct quorums; it needs a machine-readable registry of provider capabilities, credentials-present flags, rate budgets, and allowed roles.
patterns.reject_or_constrain: No OAuth/provider proxy may bypass OpenBao SecretReference and audit-chain constraints.

adopted_shape: no channel as source of truth
patterns.name: multi_channel_gateway_presence
patterns.oyatie_fit: Useful for ops notifications, but not core to autonomous_foundry until ops.oyatie.com owns channel policy and delivery audit.
patterns.reject_or_constrain: Do not add direct chat-command control paths to deployment or incident response.

adopted_shape: ephemeral isolated CI/test runners may be allowed with receipts
patterns.name: remote_shell_and_serverless_terminal_backends
patterns.oyatie_fit: Hermes supports SSH/serverless terminal backends, but user directive forbids manual SSH troubleshooting and requires OpenTofu/ops-managed deployment.
patterns.reject_or_constrain: Reject any manual SSH, scp, standalone daemon, or shell-runbook deployment path as closure authority.

source_evidence.claim: Hermes positions itself as a self-improving, cross-session, multi-platform agent with closed learning loop, scheduled automations, delegation/parallelization, and trajectory tooling.
Durable multi-agent Kanban introduced multi-profile boards, multi-project isolation, diagnostics, worker heartbeats/reclaim/retry caps, ownership enforcement, and handoff metadata.
Kanban is a durable SQLite task board where model-facing tools and human/automation CLI share one DB layer to prevent drift.
Hermes distinguishes one-shot delegation from durable queue work: durable rows, resumability, comments, audit trail, and peer handoffs.
Core Kanban entities include task states, dependency links, comments, workspaces, dispatcher, heartbeat/reclaim/crash handling, failure limits, and tenant scoping.
Hermes boards have hard per-board SQLite/workspace/log isolation and prevent cross-board task links.
Hermes runs the dispatcher inside the gateway by default and deprecates a standalone daemon to avoid claim races.
Kanban create supports idempotency keys so repeated automation returns the existing task rather than duplicating work.
Persistent goals, checkpoint pruning/disk guardrails, and auto-resume preserve long-running goals and session routing across restarts.
Hermes v0.14 added live handoff, session id exposure, subgoals, compression protection, and per-turn file mutation verification.
Hermes file mutation verifier prevents over-claiming by surfacing files that did not actually change after failed write/patch tool calls.
Autonomous Curator grades, prunes, consolidates skill libraries and background review creates/updates memory/skills under constrained toolsets.
Curator code invariants: only agent-created skills, never auto-deletes, archive recoverable, pinned skills bypass transitions, auxiliary client preserves prompt cache.
Hermes skills use progressive disclosure: list, full skill, specific reference file.
Hermes treats agent-managed skills as procedural memory created after complex tasks, errors, corrections, or discovered workflows; patch is preferred over full rewrite.
Hermes persistent memory is bounded and curated, injected at session start from MEMORY.md and USER.md.
Hermes separates small always-loaded memory from unbounded on-demand session search backed by SQLite FTS5 and summarization.
Cron can create, pause, resume, edit, trigger, remove jobs, attach skills, deliver to platforms/files, and disables cron management inside cron executions to avoid runaway loops.
Cron execution is gateway-owned, starts fresh sessions, injects skills, delivers outputs, updates metadata, and uses a file lock to prevent overlapping ticks.
Hermes has an always-on hardline blocklist that cannot be bypassed even by yolo/approval-off modes; dangerous approvals fail closed on timeout.
Hermes dangerous-pattern list covers destructive filesystem, database, service, shell, remote-script, and sensitive-write operations, with container isolation as a boundary.
Hermes added MCP parallel-tool-call support and per-turn verifier support.
Hermes plugin surface supports plugin LLM calls, tool override, out-of-process cron delivery, debug logs, and git-shareable profile distributions.

Hermes v0.14 security wave includes sudo brute-force blocking, comment author hardening, dashboard auth, output redaction, shell=True reduction, supply-chain advisory checks, and OS isolation boundary updates.
